description: This file declares the HostResolverManager class, which manages host resolution requests, including DNS lookups, cache management, and network change handling within the Chromium project. It also declares related functions and classes for DNS resolution and hostname handling.

classes.name: HostResolverManager
classes.description: Manages host resolution requests, DNS configurations, cache invalidation, and network change responses within the Chromium network stack.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a host resolution request for a given hostname or host object, with optional parameters and context.

methods.name: CreateDohProbeRequest
methods.description: Creates a DNS-over-HTTPS probe request.

methods.name: CreateMdnsListener
methods.description: Creates an mDNS listener for a specified host and query type.

methods.name: SetInsecureDnsClientEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the built-in asynchronous DNS client.

methods.name: GetDnsConfigAsValue
methods.description: Returns the current DNS configuration as a dictionary.

methods.name: SetDnsConfigOverrides
methods.description: Overrides the DNS configuration with specified settings.

methods.name: RegisterResolveContext
methods.description: Registers a resolve context for cache invalidation and network change handling.

methods.name: DeregisterResolveContext
methods.description: Deregisters a resolve context.

methods.name: InvalidateCachesForTesting
methods.description: Invalidates internal caches for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom tick clock for testing.

methods.name: SetMaxQueuedJobsForTesting
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of queued jobs for testing.

methods.name: SetMdnsSocketFactoryForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom mDNS socket factory for testing.

methods.name: SetMdnsClientForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom mDNS client for testing.

methods.name: SetDnsClientForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom DNS client for testing.

methods.name: DisableSystemResolverForTesting
methods.description: Disables the system DNS resolver for testing.

methods.name: SetLastIPv6ProbeResultForTesting
methods.description: Sets the last IPv6 probe result for testing.

methods.name: ResetIPv6ProbeTimeForTesting
methods.description: Resets the IPv6 probe timestamp for testing.

methods.name: num_running_dispatcher_jobs_for_tests
methods.description: Returns the number of currently running dispatcher jobs for testing.

methods.name: num_jobs_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the number of current jobs for testing.

methods.name: check_ipv6_on_wifi_for_testing
methods.description: Checks if IPv6 is enabled on WiFi for testing.

methods.name: target_network_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the target network handle for testing.

methods.name: https_svcb_options_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the HTTPS SVCB options for testing.
